Evidence: Flight cancellations, admin statements, system failures
#Aviation #USPol #Aletheia 🌐

More than 5,000 US flights were grounded in a massive nationwide stoppage, disrupting travel for hundreds of thousands while officials scrambled to point fingers.

The Poison:
Shifting blame to private contractors allows government agencies to evade accountability for critical infrastructure vulnerabilities.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing WHAT happened (systemic aviation failure) with WHO is convenient to blame (an external contractor) to shield political actors.

Social Physics Analysis:
Political actors ran a classic Smart Selfish Maneuver. Faced with systemic collapse, they deployed pretexts and projected blame onto contractors to protect their own standing while leaving citizens stranded.

The Trajectory: The Path of Fall into Destruction.
Modal Dynamics: will be -> is not via Red Top (The Imperial Trap).
Promising seamless operations while delivering systemic breakdown and deflection crosses the central IS barrier.

The Unavoidable Truth: Critical infrastructure collapsed under institutional neglect.

The Unavoidable Lie: A single contractor is entirely responsible for the nationwide halt.

Alethekanon:
Shifting systemic failure onto external scapegoats is a transparent evasion of institutional accountability.

Awwthekanon:
Thousands of stranded passengers bore the brunt of this sudden collapse while leaders traded blame instead of offering real care.

Brothekanon:
Classic government move: thousands of flights grounded and the first instinct is pointing fingers at someone else.
